tagline: Your digital projects, clear and secure.

login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Sign in to view your projects and messages.
login.demoHint: Demo mode: any valid email signs you in as a customer.

register.title: Create account
register.subtitle: Create a customer account with VDB Digital.
register.acceptTerms: I agree to the terms and privacy policy
register.successBody: We sent a confirmation link. Confirm your address to continue.

forgot.title: Forgot password
forgot.subtitle: We will send a reset link to your email address.
forgot.successBody: If an account exists, you will receive an email within a few minutes.

reset.title: New password
reset.subtitle: Choose a new, strong password.
reset.success: Your password was updated. You can sign in now.

verify.title: Verify email
verify.subtitle: Confirm your email address to activate your account.
verify.success: Your email address has been confirmed.
verify.failed: Confirmation failed. Request a new link.
verify.resendSuccess: A new confirmation email has been sent.
verify.resendError: Could not resend the email. Please try again.

signOutConfirm: Are you sure you want to sign out?
sessionExpired: Your session expired. Please sign in again.

accountDeletion.title: Delete account
accountDeletion.subtitle: This deletes your account and personal data according to our policy.
accountDeletion.warning: Open invoices and project history may be retained where legally required.
accountDeletion.consequence1: Your profile, messages and stored documents will be permanently removed.
accountDeletion.consequence2: Open invoices, quotes and legally required records may be retained.
accountDeletion.consequence3: This action cannot be undone once processing starts.
accountDeletion.success: Your deletion request has been received.
accountDeletion.statusSubmitted: Status: submitted — we will email you once it has been processed.
accountDeletion.error: Could not submit your deletion request. Please try again.
